questions.note: Forced buyers (investors) are compelled to buy LYNX shares on the listing session (Wednesday), as evidenced by the IPO pricing and subsequent 14% drop from the list price, indicating a forced entry at a higher price than the market valued it.

questions.question: Is the flow the issuer itself or an index vehicle?

A new defense stock is born: Lyntris IPO set for Wednesday - MSN: The defense contractor Lyntris sold 17 million shares in its IPO. The stock closed 14% below its list price of $17.50 a share, according to MarketSurge.

Defense-Tech Roll-Up Lyntris Falls 11% in Its NYSE Debut as LYNX: Lyntris priced its IPO below range, raised a little over half of what it first targeted, and then watched its stock drop on day one. That is a rough debut for a defense-tech story Wall Street was supposed to like. Lyntris Inc. started trading on the New York Stock Exchange on Wednesday under the ticker LYNX.
